Privacy notice for your installers
The Essential Services Commission requires every installer to read this notice before we register them for the VEU program. Each person ticks their own name.
VEU Scheme Participant Privacy Collection Notice
Version 1.0 – 1 October 2026

The Essential Services Commission (commission) collects personal information about scheme participants (installers). We usually collect this information from the accredited person for whom you undertake activities, including through the VEEC assignment form. The information may include your name, date of birth, company, contact details, licence and certification details and evidence of training. We collect this information to:

•assess whether scheme participants and accredited persons have undertaken prescribed activities in accordance with Victorian Energy Upgrades (VEU) program requirements, including applicable training and competency requirements for scheme participants
•assess whether Victorian Energy Efficiency Certificates (VEECs) created for prescribed activities are eligible for registration
•perform our functions under the Victorian Energy Efficiency Target Act 2007 (VEET Act) and the Essential Services Commission Act 2001 including accreditations, compliance monitoring, enforcement, and reporting.

The commission may use and disclose a scheme participant’s personal information:

•with the Energy Efficiency Council and other certification or training bodies to verify your certification and training
•for the purpose of performing the commission’s functions or exercising powers under the VEET Act
•with other persons or organisations for the purpose of those persons or organisations performing their functions and powers, including:
•government departments, including the Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action;
•Energy Safe Victoria, WorkSafe Victoria and other State, Territory or Commonwealth regulators
•persons administering other energy efficiency schemes;
•State, Territory or Commonwealth police.

The commission handles personal information in accordance with the Privacy and Data Protection Act 2014 and our privacy and confidential information policy.

If you do not provide this information, you may not be able to undertake prescribed activities, or parts of activities, for an accredited person and VEECs for the prescribed activity may not be eligible for registration.

If you have any questions about how your personal information will be handled or would like to access or correct your personal information, you can contact the commission on (03) 9032 1300 or privacy@esc.vic.gov.au.
